description: 10 Year Cycling Network Plan – On-Street (2016) is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. On June 9, 2016 Toronto City Council approved a Cycling Network Plan to Connect, Grow and Renew infrastructure for Toronto's cycling routes over the next ten years. The plan identified opportunities for cycling infrastructure investments in every part of Toronto. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are bicycle, cycling, cycling network plan, on-street. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-03-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
